title: Turnitin cyberattack, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Turnitin, any school, news outlet, company, government agency, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Turnitin's plagiarism and AI-writing checks are used by schools and universities worldwide; it says more than 16,000 institutions and 71 million students. Turnitin has not said how many people are affected, so size rests on its reach, not a count.
who_is_affected: Possibly students, teachers and schools that use Turnitin. Turnitin has not said whether anyone's data was taken. It says the service is working and safe to use and has not asked users to do anything. Watch for word from your school, and be wary of messages that only claim to be from Turnitin.

known.text: Turnitin says it found unauthorized activity in some of its customer-facing systems.
Turnitin says it called in outside cybersecurity specialists and notified police and cyber regulators.
Turnitin says its investigation is still going on and it is watching for more unauthorized activity.

not_known.text: Whether students' or teachers' data was accessed or taken.
How the intruders got in and which systems they reached. The root cause is not published.
